provenance.labels: Independent Bernoulli draws. Not real revisit outcomes.

decisionRule: TabPFN is shown in the Lab as useful only if its AUC beats logistic regression at n <= 128.
decisionImplementation: Mean paired AUC difference must be positive at all three sizes 32, 64 and 128. Report uncertainty even when this descriptive rule passes.
confidenceIntervalMethod: Two-sided Student t interval across five training repeats. The same fixed 500 test rows are reused. This does not include test-population uncertainty.
limitations: All rows and outcomes come from an invented Bernoulli formula, not real revisits.
The logistic model matches the generator's functional form. Irrelevant features and sampling noise can affect finite-sample performance.
Intervals measure training-repeat variation on one fixed test set, not test-population uncertainty.
Oracle probabilities are the Bayes rule in expectation, not a guaranteed finite-sample maximum.
Quote reservations bound free-quota consumption. They are not an independently verified invoice.
The existing live 96-row scenario model and real walk ranking are unchanged.
